rules.statement: Where a power of attorney contains recitals that indicate the purpose for which it was given, and this purpose is the management of a specific business, with the cessation of that business, the authority granted under the power of attorney is automatically cancelled.
rules.supporting_quote: "The phraseology of the recitals indicated, therefore, that the purpose for which the power was given was the management of the plaintiff's business as a timber merchant and restrained the generality of the operative part. With the closing down of that business the authority of the second defendant to act under the power of attorney was automatically cancelled."
